admission.failureEvidence: Each candidate has executable maintained positive/near-miss fixtures recorded before editing source. All 2,202 existing candidate Python tests pass on the baseline.
admission.gap: Existing warning diagnostics identify maintained policy failures but do not block CI or enter blocking baselines. The user explicitly requests strict helpful policy enforcement.
admission.noChangeHarm: Weak boundary types, unchecked narrowing, aliased model state, missing validation or substitutable contracts, uncontrolled retry wall time, and duplicate test vectors remain advisory.
admission.upstreamOwnership: Reuse all existing custom AST detectors and catalog IDs; BasedPyright owns annotation/signature compatibility, Ruff owns blocking sleep and simple append loops, and Pydantic/Zod own runtime validation. No new detector or overlapping upstream rule.
admission.classification: Promotion enforces the explicit user-selected strict policy; finite matches are classified against observed source predicates and remedy feasibility, not universal correctness or inferred API intent.

judgePasses.evidence: Independent runtime probes found legitimate framework keyword signatures, dynamic builtin replacement, descriptor-supplied ordinal bounds, None factory lifetime, shared-factory replacement and observed frame locals. Repairs narrow tiers; None default promotion withdrawn.

Independent temporary public projects found covariant-return and contravariant-input contracts, evaluated/quoted model annotation effects, and globals provider replacement. Shared signature/annotation admission and dynamic namespace gates added.

673 independently run focused tests pass. Replayed effectful Field options and canonical/nested Self now remain WARNING; ordinary identical signatures remain ERROR. No remaining concrete blocker in the finite 21-rule scope; corpus/performance/full verification and exact-head CI remain gates.

Independent immutable-pin, stable-full-Counter, control, duplicate, source-fingerprint, managed severity, ESLint preset and private structural-context checks pass. The normal runner baseline error was repaired and all three pairs rerun; original budgets pass. Report discloses policy-only classification, unknown API intent, fixture-only tiers and disabled corpus inline configuration.

Independent final audit confirms 21 promotions, five bounded WARNING tiers, nine reasoned holds, exact 30-candidate plan/catalog/preset ownership, useful manual remedies and no autofixes. Source fingerprint is unchanged; make verify passes 29,536 tests with nine existing skips and all local repository gates. Approval is scoped to this campaign; postcommit lifecycle and trusted exact-head CI remain release gates.

privacy: Private corpus identities, roots, source, revisions, digests and raw findings remain in owner-only scratch storage; public evidence reports aggregates only.
limitations: No unsafe autofix and no universal precision, recall, semantic TP/FN, or API-compatibility claim.
Runtime reflection, external plugins, unresolved ancestry and ambiguous provenance stay bounded by each existing detector.
Intentional in-place, open-interface, framework, serialization and repeat-test contracts retain reasoned local exceptions.
Regex-hoisting WARNING diagnostics remain nonblocking even though the static-table catalog default is ERROR.
The native ERROR tiers preserve WARNING for runtime signatures, model construction/annotation effects, variance/Self, regex initialization and observed frame state.

Promotion changes enforcement of explicit conventions; intentional open or in-place APIs, wire equality, external primitive ID signatures and repeat-test contracts may still require a reasoned local exception.
